title: El Toro
identity: Editions Marc Reift EMR2307E is identified as El Toro for alto saxophone and piano. A Swiss national bibliography also records separate alto-saxophone and tenor-saxophone editions, so the saxophone part must match the selected edition. The current catalog’s optional castanets/drum-set detail came from its seller listing and was not independently verified in the opened sources.

evidence.claim: Swiss National Library bibliography records El Toro as a 6-page alto saxophone and piano score with four parts, EMR2307E, issued by Marc Reift around 2007. It separately records a tenor edition.
Retailer identifies EMR2307E as alto saxophone and piano.

review_focus: Confirm which edition is held and what the optional percussion instructions require; no musical notation was inspected.
collection_flag: Available in distinct alto and tenor editions; the current alto catalog entry is consistent with one official bibliographic record.
gaps: Focused exact-code and publisher-domain searches for an EMR2307E public score PDF did not surface readable notation; no score pages were inspected.
Optional castanets/drum-set instrumentation needs confirmation from the score.
